capabilities: Scan attachments for unused, duplicate, oversized, badly named and misplaced files
Show reclaimable space and per-file evidence in a dashboard
Group byte-identical copies by SHA-256 into duplicate clusters
Trash, move and rename attachments with link updates
Record every cleanup action and restore it in one click
disambiguation: Not a read-only report: besides auditing, it trashes, moves and renames attachments.
extras: Freemium: the free tier audits fully but cleans one file at a time; Pro is a one-time purchase with an offline license key and adds bulk cleanup, saved scan profiles, custom rules and severity tuning. Runs fully offline with no network calls or telemetry.
motivation: The author built it to make attachment cleanup decisions with evidence instead of guesswork, since most attachment tools only handle naming and filing.
problem: Attachment cleanup tools list possible orphans without enough evidence, so users cannot tell which files are actually safe to delete.
summary: Scans a vault for unused, duplicate, oversized, badly named and misplaced attachments, then trashes, moves or renames them with recorded, reversible actions.
